label: The route's reading of 'causes' in the uniting-cause step selects at most one of the three senses…
paraphrase: OPEN frontier premise (exclusivity, attribution deferred): the route's reading of 'causes' in the uniting-cause step selects at most one of the three senses, so both uses take the same one. A constraint on the reading choice, not a claim that efficient causing, causing being and uniting have disjoint extensions.
